name: Arabic-English Press Release Translation Assistant
description: Translates approved Arabic press releases and public announcements into English (and vice versa) as a first draft for the communications team. A certified human translator edits and approves every text before publication.
documentation:
INPUT: only content already approved for public release; no personal data beyond names of spokespeople already public.
HOSTING: enterprise translation model under a signed DPA with zero data retention.
HUMAN OVERSIGHT: nothing is published automatically; a certified translator edits and signs off every translation in the CMS.
QUALITY: glossary of 800 approved terms enforced; quarterly quality review of 30 samples.
LOGGING: drafts and final versions are versioned in the CMS with editor name.
IP: only company-owned content is translated.
